facts.fact: 亚当倒吸一口气——Vic 身穿死神（Reaper）长袍、手握镰刀，立在满地昏倒的人中间。
facts.anchor: Adam caught his breath as Vic stood tall in his Reaper’s robe.

facts.fact: 时间放缓时，Vic 伸出空手，一只黑白色、翅膀如午夜天空的黄蜂飞来落在他摊开的掌心；他合起手指，时间重新流动。
facts.anchor: He extended his empty hand and a wasp flew to it, landing on his open palm.

facts.fact: 亚当打给精灵的接线服务，报告「几百名（several hundred）昏迷的人和一名已死的压轴歌手」，要求守护者们立刻到场。
facts.anchor: “We have several hundred unconscious people and a dead headliner. Get the Guardians here. Now.”

facts.fact: 宝剑骑士（Knight of Swords）率领精灵们赶到现场，目光锁定亚当，质问他「为什么在这里」。
facts.anchor: The knight leveled her gaze on Adam and demanded, “Why are you here?”

facts.fact: 杜特（Dautre）是骑士的侍从、也是亚当从前的搭档；听亚当描述那生物时他浑身一僵，始终不肯看亚当。

facts.fact: 亚当在近六个月前（nearly six months ago）被置于察看期，令他再度沦为最底层。
facts.anchor: he’d been placed on probation nearly six months ago, making him, once again, the lowest of the low

facts.fact: 众人离开剧院时科尔（Cole）仍未醒来；艾米丽（Emily）回头张望、满脸担忧——科尔是她的室友兼好友。
facts.anchor: She looked back, her expression worried. Cole was her roommate and friend.

facts.fact: 自「the fall」以来亚当夺走过一条人命——严格算来是两条——他感觉体内有什么东西碎了。
facts.anchor: He’d taken a life—two if you wanted to get technical about it
